evidence.reason: The generator only sets core.autocrlf/core.eol/core.safecrlf and later suppresses global/system Git config. It does not disable the global or system attributes files (e.g. core.attributesFile=/dev/null and GIT_ATTR_NOSYSTEM=1). A host global `*.ts text` attribute is still consulted by `git add` independently of GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL, so the CRLF case can be normalized to LF and produce non-deterministic blob/commit IDs.
